I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the signed paperwork puts the 2026 Quarrendon renewal at **185 seats**, not the 261 Ilse posted.

- **2026 Renewal Order Form:** signed 2026-03-20 and effective 2026-04-01. It doesn't change the seat count, so Amendment No. 1's 185 seats still apply.
- **Account record:** last updated 2026-09-30, it also shows 185 active seats.
- **Amendment No. 3:** signed 2026-09-22, it raises the count to 230 seats from 2027-01-01. That hasn't taken effect yet.

None of the signed documents I found mention 261. I suggested Dana put 185 in the tracker with a note that it goes to 230 on Jan 1, and I asked Ilse in the thread where 261 came from. I left the pricing terms in the order form out of the reply.

My summary of the first reply to Ilse was also posted in #north-team as its own message. That's harmless, but it means that note appears in the channel twice.
